Reference | [[Wall Framing]] |} '''{{PAGENAME}} Wall Framing''' is the canonical library for the load-bearing wall module of the [[Iconic CAD Housing Library]]. Every schema, compiler, validator, output and icon for this module is indexed here and nowhere else. It is the reference template for the other ICHL modules: see [[#Replicate|Replicate]]. = Scope = '''In:''' load-bearing wall framing: primary members, openings, blocking, connection faces.
'''Out:''' sheathing, insulation, finish layers, MEP, except where they constrain framing. == Interfaces == {| class="wikitable" style="font-size:95%;" ! Face !! Mates with |- | '''Side''' || Adjacent wall module, [[ICHL-015]] |- | '''Top''' || Top plate; [[ICHL-017|ICHL-017 Roof Framing]], [[ICHL-024|ICHL-024 Second Floor Platform]] |- | '''Bottom''' || Foundation base; [[ICHL-004|ICHL-004 Foundation]], [[ICHL-007|ICHL-007 Stabilized Subgrade Foundation]] |- | '''Openings''' || [[ICHL-016|ICHL-016 Window Framing]], [[ICHL-302|ICHL-302 Door Framing]] |- | '''Partition''' || [[ICHL-023|ICHL-023 Interior Walls]] |- | '''Internal''' || Studs to plates, blocking to studs |} = Library = Pipeline per asset: '''Schema → Compiler → Code validator → Output → Output validator''', per [[Schema Canon]].

A change to any schema triggers regeneration of every asset that reads it. New schema in seven steps: # '''Scope''' one asset. Geometry is shape only. # '''Describe''' it aloud, as to a framer. # '''Parameterize:''' AI turns the transcript into parameters with units, ranges, origin and placement rules. # '''Compile''' in FreeCAD or Python. # '''Validate''' the code and the output. # '''Publish''' every file with a thumbnail in its gallery above. # '''Flag''' each knowledge gap to [[OdOSEos Brain/Questions]]. Never guess. AI-generated content stays below ''Reviewed'' until a qualified human signs off. = Replicate = To build the library for any other module: # Pick a module in the [[ICHL Registry]]. # Create page ICHL-NNN and paste this page's source. # Rewrite the name, icon, Scope, Interfaces, Variants and the eleven asset lines from the registry row and source material. File names follow the page name automatically. # Reset every version to v0 and every status to Planned. # Link the registry's first column here, and the module's reference page back here. = Sources = * [[Wall Framing]]: build docs, BOM sheet, photo folder * [[Seed Eco-Home 4 Build Instructions]] * [[Iconic CAD Library for a Simple Structure]]: reference gallery pattern * [[Iconic CAD Schemas]] · [[Schema Canon]] · [[Parametric Icon Schema]] * [[Parallelizing Iconic CAD Development]] · [[Konrad Log]] [[Category:ICHL]] [[Category:Iconic CAD]]
